# AluCalc OS — Full Engineering Knowledge Base

> Comprehensive reference index of AluCalc OS (alucalculator.com) containing 90+ verified engineering solvers, deterministic mathematical formulations, material handbooks, and standard citations (ISO, DIN, VDI, ASME).

## 1. Mechanical Engineering Solvers

- [Bolted Joints & Tightening Torque](https://www.alucalculator.com/bolt-torque):
  - Standards: VDI 2230 Blatt 1, ISO 898-1, DIN EN ISO 4014
  - Formulations: Clamp load Fm = 0.9 * Rp0.2 * As, tightening torque Ma = Fm * (0.16 * P + 0.58 * d2 * mu_th + r_b * mu_b).
- [Rolling Element Bearing Life](https://www.alucalculator.com/bearings):
  - Standards: ISO 281, ISO 76, DIN 622
  - Formulations: Equivalent dynamic load P = X * Fr + Y * Fa, L10 life in millions of revolutions = (C / P)^p, L10h operating hours = (10^6 / (60 * n)) * L10.
- [Spur and Helical Gears](https://www.alucalculator.com/gears):
  - Standards: ISO 6336 Method B, DIN 3990
  - Formulations: Bending stress sigma_F = (Ft / (b * mn)) * YF * YS * Y_beta * KA * KV * KF_alpha * KF_beta. Contact stress sigma_H = ZH * ZE * Z_eps * Z_beta * sqrt((Ft / (d1 * b)) * ((u + 1) / u) * KA * KV * KH_alpha * KH_beta).
- [Keyway Parallel Keys](https://www.alucalculator.com/keyway-connection):
  - Standards: DIN 6885 Blatt 1, DIN 6892
  - Formulations: Surface pressure p = (2 * T / (d * l_eff * (h - t1))) <= p_adm. Shear stress tau = (2 * T / (d * l_eff * b)) <= tau_adm.
- [Shaft Fatigue Strength](https://www.alucalculator.com/shafts):
  - Standards: DIN 743 Teile 1-4
  - Formulations: Safety factors against fatigue failure S_sigma and S_tau under alternating bending and steady or pulsating torsion.
- [Press Fits & Interference](https://www.alucalculator.com/press-fit):
  - Standards: DIN 7190
  - Formulations: Joint pressure p = U / (d * (c_i / E_i + c_a / E_a)), transmissible torque T = pi * d^2 * l * p * mu / 2.
- [Fits & Tolerances](https://www.alucalculator.com/fits):
  - Standards: ISO 286-1, ISO 286-2, DIN 7157
  - Formulations: Standard tolerance grades IT01 through IT18, fundamental deviations A through ZC for holes and a through zc for shafts.

## 2. Structural & Beam Solvers

- [Beam Deflection & Bending](https://www.alucalculator.com/beam-deflection):
  - Standards: Euler-Bernoulli beam theory, AISC 360-16, Eurocode 3
  - Formulations: Deflection v''(x) = -M(x) / (E * I), maximum bending stress sigma = M * y / I.
- [Column Buckling](https://www.alucalculator.com/column-buckling):
  - Standards: Euler column theory, Johnson parabolic formula
  - Formulations: P_cr = pi^2 * E * I / (K * L)^2 for slender columns (lambda >= lambda_c).
- [FEA Linear Static](https://www.alucalculator.com/fea):
  - Formulations: Stiffness matrix formulation K * u = F, CST and Q4 plane stress elements, von Mises equivalent stress.

## 3. Materials & Metallurgy

- [Materials Handbook & Database](https://www.alucalculator.com/materials):
  - Standards: EN 573-3, EN 755-2, ISO 209, ASTM B221, AISI
  - Data: Yield strength, tensile ultimate strength, elongation A50, modulus of elasticity, shear modulus, density, thermal expansion coefficient.
- [Alloy Comparison](https://www.alucalculator.com/compare):
  - Certified comparative matrices for 6061-T6, 6082-T6, 7075-T6, 2024-T3, and structural steels.

## 4. Workspaces & CAD

- [3D Parametric CAD / Design Studio](https://www.alucalculator.com/design-studio): Parametric modeling with extrude, revolve, hole wizard, and assembly mates.
- [2D CAD Drafting / AluCAD](https://www.alucalculator.com/cad-editor): Planar geometric constraint solving with line, circle, arc, and dimension constraints.
